title: THE RESET · GROUND LAPS
why: GREEN (8 h, low back + upper shoulders a little sore) and you asked for mobility + core, not a recovery day. Shape rotates to the GET-UP / GROUND day (unused since 09-15): two 10:00 clocks built on the Original Strength 'pick 2, then crawl' template, get-ups and windmills on the 35 lb only, no heavy hinge, no 60 lb ballistics, short flat legs off every round.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 8 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day C FLOW + Original Strength resets · low back / upper shoulders

items.name: Crocodile breathing ×10 breaths (belly down, nose only)
Head nods + rotations ×10 each (on all fours)
Rock-backs ×15 (hands down, sit toward heels, spine long)
Segmental roll ×3 each way (lead with the arm, then the leg)
Cross-crawl ×20 (standing, opposite elbow to knee, slow)

blocks.title: CLOCK 1 · GET UP · 10:00 AMRAP
blocks.meta: 10:00 · AMRAP ROUNDS · 4 moves + one LEG per round · nasal breathing pace, bell stays at 35 lb
blocks.format: Score = rounds finished (green 5 / stretch 6 / yellow 4). Rest only what the breath needs.
blocks.workRest: LEG every round: 0.15 mi flat @ 8.0 mph.

items.name: Get-up 35 lb ×1/side
items.detail: slow, eyes on the bell, bell locked out the whole way

items.name: Arm bar 35 lb 20s/side
items.detail: roll onto the hip, bell locked out, shoulder packed

items.name: Rocking cross crawl ×10/side
items.detail: on all fours: rock back, then opposite knee to elbow

blocks.noteGreen: Green = 5 rounds. Stretch = 6. Log rounds + RPE.
blocks.text: Arm bar: lie on your back, bell locked out over the chest, roll onto the opposite hip and let the shoulder settle. Rocking cross crawl: all fours, rock the hips back to the heels, come forward and touch opposite knee to opposite elbow, alternate. 2 min transition to Clock 2.

blocks.title: CLOCK 2 · CRAWL · 10:00 AMRAP
blocks.meta: 10:00 · AMRAP ROUNDS · 4 moves + one LEG per round · the Original Strength 'then crawl' half
blocks.workRest: LEG every round: 0.15 mi flat @ 8.0 mph.

items.name: Leopard crawl 15 yd forward + 15 yd BACKWARD
items.detail: knees an inch off the floor, hips level, nose breathing

items.name: Glute bridge 60 lb ×12 (2-ct squeeze)
items.detail: bell on the hips, ribs down

items.name: Drag-through 35 lb ×16
items.detail: WILDCARD (13 d) · hand-and-toe position, hips still, pass the bell under

items.name: Pallof hold-out 35 lb ×8/side, 3-ct
items.detail: tall-kneeling, bell held out at arm's length

blocks.noteGreen: Green = 4 rounds. Stretch = 5. Log rounds + which move slowed you.
blocks.text: Leopard crawl backward: same shape, drive from the hands, look where you are going. Glute bridge: heels close, drive through the heels, hold the top for 2. Pallof hold-out: both hands on the bell at the chest, push it straight out, hold 3, back in; the body does not rotate.

blocks.title: THE RESET FINISH · 3 ROUNDS
blocks.meta: 3 ROUNDS · anti-extension + rotation control close · straight through

items.name: Dead bug ×10/side, 2-ct
items.detail: low back stays glued to the floor

items.name: Rolling ab wiper ×6/side
items.detail: on your back, arms out wide, legs up, lower the legs side to side under control

items.name: Elevated rock-back ×10, 3-ct hold
items.detail: hands and toes only, knees off the floor, rock back to the heels
